partners.mechanism_chain: GDAP1 (HGNC:14224) —LEADS_TO→ Axonal neuropathy (HP:0003474); GDAP1 (HGNC:14224) —DISRUPTS→ Oxidative stress response (GO:0006974); PEX14 (HGNC:9204) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisome biogenesis and function (GO:0005777); Peroxisome biogenesis and function (GO:0005777) —LEADS_TO→ Peroxisome biogenesis disorder (HP:0001250); Peroxisome biogenesis and function (GO:0005777) —DISRUPTS→ Oxidative stress response (GO:0006974); Oxidative stress response (GO:0006974) —INCREASES→ Reactive Oxygen Species (CHEBI:17796); Reactive Oxygen Species (CHEBI:17796) —DISRUPTS→ Axonal neuropathy (HP:0003474). Mutations in GDAP1 (causing CMT2K) and PEX14 (causing PBD13A) both disrupt peroxisomal function. PEX14 is essential for peroxisome biogenesis, and its dysfunction leads to a general failure in peroxisomal processes, including the detoxification of reactive oxygen species. GDAP1 mutations, while primarily linked to axonal neuropathy, also impair mitochondrial and peroxisomal function, contributing to oxidative stress. The convergence is on the shared cellular compartment (peroxisome) and the resulting dysregulation of oxidative stress response, which can impact neuronal integrity.
